entries.title: Proverbs 14:1
segments: ¶The wise woman builds her house, But the foolish pulls it down with her hands.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:2
segments: ¶He who walks in his uprightness fears the LORD, But [he who is] perverse in his ways despises Him.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:3
segments: ¶In the mouth of a fool [is] a rod of pride, But the lips of the wise will preserve them.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:4
segments: ¶Where no oxen [are], the trough [is] clean; But much increase [comes] by the strength of an ox.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:5
segments: ¶A faithful witness does not lie, But a false witness will utter lies.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:6
segments: ¶A scoffer seeks wisdom and does not [find it], But knowledge [is] easy to him who understands.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:7
segments: ¶Go from the presence of a foolish man, When you do not perceive [in him] the lips of knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:8
segments: ¶The wisdom of the prudent [is] to understand his way, But the folly of fools [is] deceit.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:9
segments: ¶Fools mock at sin, But among the upright [there is] favor.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:10
segments: ¶The heart knows its own bitterness, And a stranger does not share its joy.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:11
segments: ¶The house of the wicked will be overthrown, But the tent of the upright will flourish.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:12
segments: ¶There is a way [that seems] right to a man, But its end [is] the way of death.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:13
segments: ¶Even in laughter the heart may sorrow, And the end of mirth [may be] grief.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:14
segments: ¶The backslider in heart will be filled with his own ways, But a good man [will be satisfied] from above.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:15
segments: ¶The simple believes every word, But the prudent considers well his steps.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:16
segments: ¶A wise [man] fears and departs from evil, But a fool rages and is self-confident.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:17
segments: ¶A quick-tempered [man] acts foolishly, And a man of wicked intentions is hated.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:18
segments: ¶The simple inherit folly, But the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:19
segments: ¶The evil will bow before the good, And the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:20
segments: ¶The poor [man] is hated even by his own neighbor, But the rich [has] many friends.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:21
segments: ¶He who despises his neighbor sins; But he who has mercy on the poor, happy [is] he.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:22
segments: ¶Do they not go astray who devise evil? But mercy and truth [belong] to those who devise good.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:23
segments: ¶In all labor there is profit, But idle chatter [leads] only to poverty.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:24
segments: ¶The crown of the wise is their riches, [But] the foolishness of fools [is] folly.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:25
segments: ¶A true witness delivers souls, But a deceitful [witness] speaks lies.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:26
segments: ¶In the fear of the LORD [there is] strong confidence, And His children will have a place of refuge.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:27
segments: The fear of the LORD [is] a fountain of life, To turn [one] away from the snares of death.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:28
segments: ¶In a multitude of people [is] a king's honor, But in the lack of people [is] the downfall of a prince.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:29
segments: ¶[He who is] slow to wrath has great understanding, But [he who is] impulsive exalts folly.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:30
segments: ¶A sound heart [is] life to the body, But envy [is] rottenness to the bones.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:31
segments: ¶He who oppresses the poor reproaches his Maker, But he who honors Him has mercy on the needy.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:32
segments: ¶The wicked is banished in his wickedness, But the righteous has a refuge in his death.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:33
segments: ¶Wisdom rests in the heart of him who has understanding, But [what is] in the heart of fools is made known.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:34
segments: ¶Righteousness exalts a nation, But sin [is] a reproach to [any] people.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:35
segments: ¶The king's favor [is] toward a wise servant, But his wrath [is against] him who causes shame.
